prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Caldera Wildfire Detection and Suppression Support System: advisory-only; human verification/approval; no autonomous dispatch/control/release. Require segmentation/time-sync/health-checks/audits; timestamp/georeference/status observations; timestamp/participants/radio-status coordination. Actors: local fire agencies, county emergency management, state wildland fire resources, aviation support units, cooperating public safety partners, command staff. Caldera Incident Command Portal (Emberhall): Duty Detection Officer (Orion) reviews Thermal Spot Snippet; searchable advance/hold/dismiss reasons; renders role-based maps; produces approved-layer Crew Staging Pin(time/accuracy/incident-ID). County Emergency Liaison sends jurisdiction-reviewed Drone Corridor Permit; receives confidence/threat/coordination. North Lookout Camera Mast sends snippet/bearing/confidence; South Lookout Camera Mast supplies independent bearing/Camera Cleaning Log. Horizon Ridge Drone Dock (Kestrel): charging/positioning/launch/recovery/security/health; Battery Swap Ticket; must report readiness/health/recovery before task release. Drone Tasking Service converts approved reconnaissance objectives into missions(footprints/windows/images/altitudes/revisits/abort-criteria), avoiding aviation lanes. Drone Pilot Operator verifies field-compatible route/safety/endurance/noninterference. Reconnaissance imagery verifies access/spread/structure-exposure before crew assignment. Sentinel Fireline Analytics Engine (Lantern) traceably compares reconnaissance/cameras/weather projections. Smoke Classifier Module supplies Ridge Shadow Mask/likelihood/growth/obscuration; never sole fire/aircraft-commitment basis. Confirmation requires persistent smoke/thermal plus independent corroboration or authorized visual judgment. Confirmed Ignition State retains location/confidence/history/reviewer/posture; approval gates dispatch. MesoWest Weather Fusion Node (Brindle) publishes Wind Shift Bulletin; terrain-aware weather supports spread probability bands. Maps require provenance/version/acceptance; conflicts need review; firelines require confidence/sensor-age/positional-error. Air Attack Supervisor (Redtail) reviews promoted location/confidence/airspace, authorizes reconnaissance/retardant planning, deconflicts launches/releases; bulletin informs sequencing/holds/approaches. Airspace Restricted State limits dispatch pending route/altitude acceptance. Talon Air Tanker Dispatch Console (Marigold) tracks availability/arrival/turnaround/priority; blocks incomplete approvals/airspace/readiness; produces Runway Release Note after runway validation. Tanker Base Manager checks batch slip against aircraft/quantity and resolves discrepancies. East Retardant

New part:
S146: The Crewline Mobile Tablet shows approved suppression objectives, aircraft caution areas, and current assignment notes for crews operating near the incident.
S147: The Helitack Crew Leader acknowledges nearby aircraft activity before personnel are moved into a drop zone or a reconnaissance overflight area.
S148: The Talon Air Tanker Dispatch Console sends the Suppression Drop Receipt after a completed drop has been recorded and checked for required timing fields.
S149: During extended attack, the Caldera Incident Command Portal preserves each aviation decision with the approving supervisor, operational period, and reason for change.
S150: The County Emergency Liaison can view approved aviation status and public safety implications without gaining authority to alter dispatch or suppression records.
S151: If reconnaissance, loading status, or weather guidance conflicts with an active plan, the system holds the affected recommendation for Air Attack Supervisor review before further action.
S152: This section describes how helitack and ground crews receive assignments, staging information, hazards, and updated intelligence from the support system during active wildfire operations.
S153: When a held recommendation is cleared, the Air Attack Supervisor selects the operational intent in the Caldera Incident Command Portal.
S154: The Caldera Incident Command Portal records each assignment package with an objective, time validity, confirmation status, and required acknowledgments.
S155: The Crewline Mobile Tablet displays the current division assignment, route guidance, rally location, and assigned communications channel for the logged-in crew.
S156: The Helitack Crew Leader receives the same operational package with aviation constraints and landing zone notes after Air Attack Supervisor approval.
S157: Ground crew assignments are formatted for field execution and avoid analytic scores that are not needed for tactical movement.
S158: Staging information is maintained as georeferenced areas and route descriptions so that crews can confirm location without relying on informal landmarks.
S159: The Crewline Mobile Tablet caches the latest accepted staging information and marks any expired package as unavailable for execution.
S160: If the Confirmed Ignition State changes the perimeter or priority area, the Caldera Incident Command Portal marks affected crew assignments for review before release.
S161: The Sentinel Fireline Analytics Engine updates hazard summaries when fire spread estimates, access constraints, or field observations change.
S162: The Sentinel Fireline Analytics Engine applies the Ridge Shadow Mask when estimating crew-visible fire edge confidence in steep terrain.
S163: The Smoke Classifier Module uses the Camera Cleaning Log to suppress confidence changes caused by lens contamination and service timing.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
